# Feedback messages and outgoing send progress use separate routes

The migration sends general status through MailServices.feedback and window postMessage payloads, while a prepared outgoing send still passes its own _sendProgress object to the server. The SMTP server queries that object for nsIWebProgressListener and reports byte counts. MessageSend's requestPromise wait represents send start and the cancellation handle; it does not by itself establish final delivery. Preserve these separate channels when removing window feedback plumbing.

Scope: Mail feedback service migration.
